title: New CLI commands added without test coverage

finding.claim: New CLI commands added without test coverage
finding.recommendation: Add unit tests for the new CLI subcommands (_sarif_main, _policy_main, _evidence_main, _setup_main, _doctor_main, _record_verify_main, _disputes_main, _locate_main, _bench_main, _acceptance_main) and ensure they exercise the new argument parsing and core logic paths.

refutation.reason: No panel refutation was recorded for this finding — it reached the workup undisputed. The opposing/confirmatory position is the executed probe in SS3 of the packet: Coverage map (closing workup): the suite's CLI-level tests were mapped by subcommand. Subcommands WITH functional main-level tests: review, verify, records (scan), precedents, disputes (incl. main), shadow (main flows), doctor partially. Subcommands whose only coverage is help/argparse-level: evidence, acceptance, pr, workflow, loop. The probes in this workup exercised four of those five directly — and two of the workup's six fixes live behind main-level paths (evidence exit-2, doctor guard), which is the practical cost of the gap: bugs at the main seam are found by reviewers, not by the suite.
refutation.provenance: none-recorded: no dispute exists in the source record; the workup probe is the only counter-position
